name: Riverview
seo_title: Christmas Events for Kids in Riverview, FL 2026
seo_desc: Christmas events for kids in Riverview, Florida for 2026: the Alafia Lighted Boat Parade, Apollo Beach's boat parade and Santa brunches, with dates checked.
lede: Riverview celebrates Christmas on the water, with the Alafia Lighted Boat Parade at the Civic Center, Apollo Beach's lighted boat parade and a Santa brunch and tree lighting on U.S. 41.
celebrates: Riverview's Christmas season centers on the water. The FishHawk-Riverview Rotary Club hosts the Alafia Lighted Boat Parade at the Riverview Civic Center on December 5, with decorated boats on the Alafia River, photos with Santa inside the civic center and a Wish Tree Lane of nonprofit trees. Neighboring Apollo Beach adds its own Lighted Boat Parade from the Tampa Sailing Squadron on December 12, and Salty Shamrock Irish Pub hosts Santa brunches and the second annual Official Apollo Beach Christmas Tree Lighting along U.S. 41.
lastyear: The Alafia Lighted Boat Parade is in its 41st year in 2026, according to the Rotary Club, so 2025 was the 40th. The Osprey Observer says the Apollo Beach tree lighting, now in its second year, has taken the place of the former Apollo Beach Golf Cart Parade, which Costa Living says ICON EV counted at nearly 400 decorated carts in 2022. The Tampa Sailing Squadron's earlier boat parade listing described a chili cook-off and awards at the clubhouse after the boats.
facts: The Alafia Lighted Boat Parade raises money for local and global organizations through the FishHawk-Riverview Rotary Club Foundation and Friends of the County Parks and Recreation, and after the parade the boats go to River's Edge Bar and Grill in Gibsonton for the winners announcement. The Tampa Sailing Squadron, established in 1964 according to its website, holds the Apollo Beach parade with Yacht Star Ship Cruises. Apollo Beach's Christmas tree stands 26 feet tall, the Osprey Observer says.
trains: We did not find a Christmas train ride in Riverview or Apollo Beach. Nearby, Santa's Carnival at Tampa Bay's Festival of Lights at the Hillsborough County Fairgrounds in Dover, open through December 27, shows a Santa Train on its Dreamland Amusements page, and Dinosaur World in Plant City runs the Candy Cane Express. The Henry B. Plant Museum in Tampa has an Age of Rail and Steam exhibit and holds its Victorian Christmas Stroll through December 31, and the Willaford Railroad Museum in Plant City is free.
train_links: The 1891 Tampa Bay Hotel with an Age of Rail and Steam exhibit and a Victorian Christmas Stroll.
A free railroad museum in the 1909 Plant City union depot with a 1963 Seaboard caboose.
traditions: Decorated boats on the Alafia River, with Santa photos and Wish Tree Lane at the Riverview Civic Center.
A school choir, boats gathering at 6 pm and a chili cook-off at the Tampa Sailing Squadron.
A 26-foot tree on U.S. 41 with real snow, Santa and a gingerbread display all December.
Brunch with Santa and Mrs. Claus on two Saturdays at an Apollo Beach pub.
kidfact: At the Alafia boat parade, kids can sit for a photo with Santa on a decorated stage inside the civic center.
faq: The FishHawk-Riverview Rotary Club hosts the Alafia Lighted Boat Parade at the Riverview Civic Center on December 5. Nearby Apollo Beach has its own lighted boat parade on December 12, a Christmas tree lighting on December 5 and Santa brunches at Salty Shamrock.
Is there a free Christmas event in Riverview?
Yes. The Alafia Lighted Boat Parade is free to watch, according to the Rotary Club. The other events on this page list each host's price or say that no price is printed.
Where can kids meet Santa in Riverview?

Santa is on the decorated stage inside the Riverview Civic Center at the Alafia Lighted Boat Parade on December 5. In Apollo Beach, Salty Shamrock lists Santa and Mrs. Claus brunches on November 28 and December 12, and the tree lighting on December 5 has Santa photos.
Is there a Christmas train ride near Riverview?

We did not find one in Riverview. Santa's Carnival at Tampa Bay's Festival of Lights in Dover shows a Santa Train on its Dreamland Amusements page, and Dinosaur World in Plant City has the Candy Cane Express.
When is the Alafia Lighted Boat Parade in 2026?
Saturday, December 5, 2026, from 4 to 7 pm at the Riverview Civic Center, with the first boat pass around 6 pm.

intro_html:
Rally the corgi has sniffed out the best Christmas events for kids in Riverview for 2026, and here is what he found: 3 family events, 1 of them free. The magic runs from November 28 (Brunch with Santa and Mrs. Claus at Salty Shamrock in Apollo Beach) through December 12 (the Apollo Beach Lighted Boat Parade), with the Alafia Lighted Boat Parade (December 5) and the Apollo Beach Christmas Tree Lighting (December 5) along the way. We check every date on the host's own website, and each listing links straight there.
